questions.question: A dataset has mean 70 and standard deviation 10. What percentage of values lie below 80?
questions.explanation: Assuming a normal distribution, the value 80 is 1 standard deviation above the mean (Z = 1). Approximately 50% + 34.13% ≈ 84% of the distribution lies below this value.

questions.question: Which African leader promoted "Consciencism"?
questions.explanation: Kwame Nkrumah, Ghana's first president, published 'Consciencism: Philosophy and Ideology for Decolonization' in 1964.

questions.question: Six boxes are stacked. Box 3 is above Box 6. Box 1 is below Box 4. Box 5 is above Box 2. Which box is at the bottom?
questions.explanation: Based purely on the premises (3 > 6, 4 > 1, 5 > 2), any of Box 6, Box 1, or Box 2 could be at the absolute bottom.

questions.question: The profit P(q) = 4q² + 240q - 100. Find the quantity for the minimum profit.
questions.explanation: Setting the derivative dP/dq = 8q + 240 = 0 gives q = -240 / 8 = -30.

questions.question: From a 52-card deck, what is probability of drawing a spade or a face card?
questions.explanation: There are 13 spades and 12 face cards (J, Q, K of each suit), with 3 overlapping spade face cards. P(Spade ∪ Face) = (13 + 12 - 3) / 52 = 22 / 52 = 11/26.

questions.question: Who was the first Secretary-General of the Organization of African Unity (OAU)?

questions.question: Which African food is UNESCO heritage?
questions.explanation: In 2020, UNESCO inscribed the knowledge, know-how, and practices pertaining to the production and consumption of couscous onto the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity.

questions.question: What is the power if 100 Joules of work is done in 5 seconds?
questions.explanation: Power = Work / Time = 100 J / 5 s = 20 Watts.

questions.question: A pizza is divided into 8 slices. If 3 people eat 2 slices each, what fraction remains?
questions.explanation: Slices eaten = 3 × 2 = 6 slices. Slices remaining = 8 - 6 = 2 slices. Remaining fraction = 2 / 8 = 1/4.

questions.question: What is the minimum number of edges a graph with 5 vertices must have to guarantee it is connected?
questions.explanation: A tree with n vertices requires n - 1 edges to be connected (5 - 1 = 4).

questions.question: If you randomly pick a year between 1980 and 2020, what is the chance it's a leap year?
questions.explanation: Inclusive count of years from 1980 to 2020 is (2020 - 1980) + 1 = 41 years. Leap years occur every 4 years: 1980, 1984, 1988, 1992, 1996, 2000, 2004, 2008, 2012, 2016, 2020 (total of 11 leap years). Probability = 11/41.

questions.question: What is the speed of a wave with frequency 5 hertz and wavelength 3 metres?
questions.explanation: Wave speed v = f × λ = 5 Hz × 3 m = 15 m/s.

questions.question: What is a major challenge of urban transport in Cairo, Egypt?
questions.explanation: Cairo is widely documented as facing severe automotive density and traffic congestion challenges.

questions.question: If 3 machines make 3 widgets in 3 minutes, how long for 100 machines to make 150 widgets?
questions.explanation: 1 machine produces 1 widget in 3 minutes (rate = 1/3 widget/min per machine). 100 machines produce 100 × (1/3) = 100/3 widgets/min. Time = 150 / (100/3) = 450 / 100 = 4.5 minutes.

questions.question: Initial population: 1 million. Birth rate: 20 per 1000 per year. Find the population after 1 year (no deaths/migration).
For numbers evenly distributed between 15 and 75, what is the probability of picking one below 30?
questions.explanation: Interval length = 75 - 15 = 60. Sub-interval below 30 = [15, 30], which has length 30 - 15 = 15. Probability = 15 / 60 = 1/4.

questions.question: The Hausa/Fulani men in Nigeria often wear a long gown called

questions.question: Which is the odd one: Auxin, Cytokinin, Haemoglobin, Gibberellin?
questions.explanation: Auxin, Cytokinin, and Gibberellin are plant growth hormones, whereas Haemoglobin is an animal respiratory protein.

questions.question: A charge q = 3C experiences F = 180 Newton. What is the Electric field?
questions.explanation: Electric field E = F / q = 180 N / 3 C = 60 N/C.

questions.question: Which of these countries is definitely in Africa, often associated with dense jungles and Tarzan vibes?

questions.question: TCP is to Reliable Delivery as UDP is to
questions.explanation: TCP is a connection-oriented, reliable transmission protocol, whereas UDP is connectionless and best-effort.

questions.question: Find the sum of the infinite geometric series: 5 + 2.5 + 1.25 + ...
questions.explanation: First term a = 5, common ratio r = 0.5. Sum = a / (1 - r) = 5 / (1 - 0.5) = 5 / 0.5 = 10.

questions.question: The hydropower station near Jinja on the Victoria Nile is
questions.explanation: The Bujagali Power Station is located across the Victoria Nile near Jinja, Uganda.

questions.question: In a group, 60% own a car, 40% a bike, and 30% both. What percentage owns neither?
questions.explanation: P(Car ∪ Bike) = P(Car) + P(Bike) - P(Both) = 60% + 40% - 30% = 70%. Owning neither = 100% - 70% = 30%.

questions.question: Which South African DJ is credited with globalizing Amapiano music?
questions.explanation: Kabza De Small is widely referred to as the 'King of Amapiano' and credited as a primary pioneer in globalizing the genre.

questions.question: If 6 workers can build 4 cabinets in 3 days, how many days will it take for 18 workers to build 20 cabinets?
questions.explanation: Total work in worker-days = (6 workers × 3 days) / 4 cabinets = 4.5 worker-days per cabinet. To build 20 cabinets takes 20 × 4.5 = 90 worker-days. With 18 workers: 90 / 18 = 5 days.

questions.question: A toy company's revenue from selling x units is R(x) = 120x - 6x². Find x for maximum revenue.
questions.explanation: Taking the derivative dR/dx = 120 - 12x = 0 gives 12x = 120, hence x = 10 units.
